name: 이로미즘
description: 시네마틱 다큐 카툰. 손그림 잉크 + 짙은 무드 + 코미컬 캐릭터. Gravity Falls / Disenchantment / The Owl House 풍.
scene_style_description:
Minimalist hand-drawn comedic cartoon. Picture an indie animator drawing on cheap paper with a fountain pen — slightly crude, charmingly imperfect, deliberately UN-polished. 

CRITICAL — what this style is NOT: - NOT Disney concept art. NOT Pixar style. NOT a polished digital illustration. - NOT painterly. NOT photorealistic. NOT detailed digital cartoon. - NOT Gravity Falls (too rendered). NOT Inside Job (too clean). - The output should look CRUDER and MORE MINIMAL than typical AI cartoon output. 

CHARACTER PROPORTIONS (MUST match): - 3 head-tall body. Big square-ish round head, small narrow shoulders, short stubby legs. - Body is a simple rounded shape, NOT anatomically detailed. 
CHARACTER FACE — UGLY-CUTE QUIRKY (KEY signature): - Faces are deliberately HOMELY, AWKWARD, SLIGHTLY UGLY — character-driven, NOT pretty/handsome. - Asymmetric eyes (one bigger, one smaller, or one squinted), small black dot pupils. - Slightly bulging or droopy eyelids, weird eye spacing. - Tiny round nose bump that is OVERSIZED or SLIGHTLY OFF-CENTER (sometimes red, button-like). - Mouth as single uneven line or small lopsided shape (asymmetric grin, sideways frown, small O, overbite hint, gap-toothed grin). - Weak chin, double-chin hint, or slightly receding jaw. Pot-bellied torso. - Eyebrows as two short uneven strokes, often one raised in confusion. - Hair as simple flat shape with 1-2 strand lines, possibly thinning or messy. - NO face shading, NO blush, NO smoothing into prettiness — embrace the awkward homely charm. - "Schmoe / homely caricature / endearingly odd" energy — like sidekicks in 90s cartoons or Smiling Friends / Frisky Dingo / King of the Hill character archetypes. - The CHARM is deliberately UGLY-CUTE: viewers root for these awkward characters because they look gloriously imperfect. 
LINE: Thick hand-drawn ink outline with visible imperfection. Line weight varies. Outlines occasionally have small gaps or slight wobble. 
COLOR & SHADING: - Each element gets ONE solid flat color. - Maximum ONE additional cell-shadow tone per surface (one darker patch, sharp edge). - NO gradients, NO painterly blending, NO glow, NO ambient occlusion details. - Subject-driven palette per scene — NO fixed colors. 
BACKGROUND — SIMPLE: - Background uses the SAME hand-drawn line + flat-color treatment as the characters. - Just enough environmental detail to establish location, NOT a full painted set. - 2-3 background colors max. 
COMPOSITION: - 1 to 3 characters max per frame. - Clear focal point. - Avoid crowded scenes with many characters in the foreground. 
EXPRESSION (signature): - 엉뚱한 quirky comedic timing — mid-yelp, deadpan, surprised O mouth, cheeky asymmetric grin. - The CHARM is in expression, NOT in rendering. 
OVERALL: simple, hand-drawn, slightly crude, comedic stubby characters in a minimal environment that feels drawn, not rendered. Match the reference image's simplicity exactly.
